answer_text:
Northwind CRM is a strong product, but growing teams often look elsewhere once per-seat costs climb or setup needs an admin. Good alternatives:

1. Pipewell Flow - the forecasting specialist: scenario planning and deal-risk scoring out of the box.
2. Tallyfox Pipelines - drag-and-drop pipelines with weighted forecasts — lighter than enterprise tools, but enough for most B2B teams under 50 reps.
3. Kestrel CRM - young but moving fast; forecasting is still in beta.

Pipewell is the safest default here; Tallyfox is worth a look if forecasting matters most.
